column3: Full-body front view of H as a young man in his early twenties (same face but younger, smooth skin), standing with arms crossed, confident grin.
Full-body front view of H in his forties: the same face with a short grey-flecked beard and a few forehead lines, standing, hands on hips, still very muscular.
Full-body front view of H in his sixties: the same face with a short white beard, white eyebrows and deeper wrinkles, still fit and muscular, proud thumbs up.
Close-up from the chest up: H completely drenched in sweat, big sweat drops flying, a towel on one shoulder, exhausted face, dramatic.
Waist-up: H sitting at a small table happily eating a big plate of grilled chicken, eggs and rice with a fork.
Side view of H sleeping peacefully in a simple bed under a blanket, calm smile, the whole bed visible.

Five flexed right arms in a row from left to right, each one bigger than the previous: 1 a very skinny noodle arm, 2 a small bump, 3 a medium muscular arm, 4 a big muscular arm, 5 a huge bodybuilder arm. Same skin tone and comic style as the reference, a black wrist wrap on each, no character body, no numbers, no text.
Full body: H turned sideways trying to squeeze his huge arms through a narrow doorway, stuck in the door frame, embarrassed funny face, the door frame drawn simply.
Back view of H from the waist up, flexing his right arm down and back to show a big triceps (the back of the upper arm), head turned to the side.
Full body: H slumped on a sofa after a huge meal, one hand on his full belly, empty plates on a small table next to him, sleepy satisfied face.
Full-body side view of H walking to the right, relaxed and happy, mid-stride with the left leg forward and the right arm swinging forward.
Full body: H walking past an open fridge full of food, looking at it with temptation but still walking away from it, funny face, the fridge drawn simply.
Close-up from the chest up: H holding his right elbow with his left hand, wincing in pain.

Anatomy illustration of a man's right elbow and forearm in the same comic style: the muscles bright red and full of blood vessels, the tendons near the elbow pale white with very few vessels, clear contrast, no labels, no text, no full body.
Full-body side view: H pushing against a plain wall with both hands, arms slightly bent, body still, calm controlled face (an isometric hold), the wall drawn as a simple vertical surface.
Full body: H sitting bored on a sofa with his right arm in a sling, a TV remote in his left hand.
Full body: H slumped and tired, shoulders down, sad face, a big empty red battery icon floating above his head.
H lying in bed at night wide awake, his face lit by a phone screen, dark circles under his eyes, the bed visible.
Full body: H lying on a sofa eating chips, ignoring a dumbbell on the floor next to the sofa.
IMPORTANT BODY CHANGE: H with a soft round belly and less muscle, holding his belly with both hands, sad face, full body, same face and outfit.
Waist-up: H sitting at a table with many empty beer bottles, sleepy half-closed eyes.
Full-body side view: H sitting hunched at a desk in front of a laptop, bored and pale.
Full body: H walking happily with sunglasses, arms swinging, a small simple drawn sun above him.

The exact same small chibi character as the reference (same face, white H mark, electric purple t-shirt, black shorts, same belt and shoes), full body, laughing hard and pointing at something to his left.

The exact same small chibi character as the reference (same face, white H mark, electric purple t-shirt, black shorts, same belt and shoes), full body, embarrassed, covering his mouth with both hands, blushing.
The exact same small chibi character as the reference (same face, white H mark, electric purple t-shirt, black shorts, same belt and shoes), full body, scared, both hands on his cheeks, eyes wide.
